text:
**No, the evidence doesn't show any tree clearing on this property after 2020, but it can't rule out very small removals.**

- The Hansen data show only 0.4 ha of tree cover (≥30% canopy) on the 130.9 ha property in 2000. That is below the 0.5 ha minimum event size, so any loss there is too small to be reported as an event.
- The JRC 2020 reference maps 0 ha of forest on the property, so almost no forest was present at the 2020 baseline to be cut afterwards.
- Coverage is complete: all three sources are available, Hansen data are fully valid, and the annual series runs through 2025.

Caveats: the tool returned no explicit loss observations for 2021–2025, and no result from the MGAP 2021 national forest cartography, so I can't comment on it. Scattered trees, small shelterbelts, or clearings under 0.5 ha (at 30 m resolution) wouldn't be detected. The engine is also an early-access version.
